name: SEKA SPEAR RDC
why_interesting: A premium domestic aero platform with a claimed 685 g bare frame, threaded BSA bottom bracket and a separately documented 7.1 kg custom build.
missing: Proof that the reported price maps to the complete listed build
Current mainland exact-SKU checkout and stock

facts.drivetrain: Shimano Ultegra electronic; exact series unconfirmed
facts.frame: SEKA SPEAR RDC MR frame; official bare-frame claim 685 g ±35 g
facts.cockpit: 375×120 mm integrated handlebar on the custom build; official frameset uses the Rapier integrated bar
facts.sizes: XS, S, M, MR, L, LR and XL; official stack 508–600 mm and reach 362–402 mm
facts.warranty: Official China policy: lifetime frameset, five years carbon parts, two years spare parts; dealer, WeChat and Taobao support routes
facts.stiffness_evidence: Manufacturer white paper reports a 14.5% stiffness-to-weight improvement over Exceed RDC for the exact Spear RDC; comparative manufacturer result with limited public protocol detail

source_note: The exact Spear RDC white paper reports a 14.5% stiffness-to-weight improvement over Exceed RDC while retaining the existing 685 ±35 g bare-frame claim. It is a manufacturer comparison, not independent validation.
